propositions: The DC harness errored all 62 cells at setup due to an ordering deadlock where the session-start Epic-field readiness gate waited for a capability that only existed after project provisioning
GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup, making them unavailable at session-start gates

The proven mechanism: 180 seconds of quiet time produced no change in field inventory (27 fields, 0 customfield_* entries), but project creation produced the Epic fields within 0.0512 seconds, proving the defect is ordering not budget

The original diagnosis that the 600s field-ready budget was too short was incorrect and self-confirming; identical inventories expired at both 600s and 1800s while the container remained idle after plugin upgrades completed

The fix relocates the Epic-field capability check from session-start to post-project-creation in _assert_project_capabilities, reorders the probe's _await_named_fields to run after project create, and lowers the budget to 120s sized from measured provisioning time

The misleading decision rule in not_ready_message that attributed zero customfield_* entries to plugin startup was rewritten to name the actual provisioning precondition and clarify that waiting cannot help if no project exists
